hooks.command: printf '\n## Session start %s UTC — %s [%s]\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M)" "$(basename "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR")" "$(git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo no-branch)" | bash ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/journal/append.sh

sha=$(git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; grep -q "commit $sha" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/journal/$(date +%F).md" 2>/dev/null && exit 0; msg="$(date -u +%H:%MZ) commit $sha — $(git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" log -1 --format=%s)"; printf -- '- %s\n' "$msg" | bash ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/journal/append.sh

hooks.prompt: A commit was just made. Review the committed changes. If they introduced new patterns, commands, architecture changes, or gotchas that should be documented in CLAUDE.md, update it now. Otherwise do nothing.
